newsitem.title: USA: US stocks rally at opening as bonds surge.
newsitem.headline: US stocks rally at opening as bonds surge.

text.p: Wall Street stocks rallied at the opening Wednesday following lower-than-expected U.S. retail sales figures and the seventh straight month of falling producer prices.
The Dow industrials rose more than 50 points in the first few minutes of trading, helped by a pre-market rally in bonds, which soared more than a percentage point.
The Dow was up 71.77 points 8032.61, with Nasdaq up 19.56 points at 1595.80.
The New York Stock Exchange imposed curbs on index-arbitrage trade at 0938 EDT/1338 GMT.
The long bond was up 1-2/32, pushing the yield down to 6.59 percent, as fears about inflation and higher interest rates subsided, analysts said.
